summary: Phase 2 Solution-Store bulk factor-value ingestion fully validated end-to-end. Backend pytest suite: 21/21 PASS. Frontend smoke (mobile 390x844): owner /tools/bulk-factor-update renders all 3 method cards (XLS template, Google Sheet link, API/Webhook), 'Generate token' produces sk_ing_* secret + webhook endpoint URL + Copy buttons + sample; admin /tools/factor-submissions renders Pending/Approved/Rejected tabs, lists pending submissions, expand shows row preview (factor_name + value + unit + factor_type), and Approve/Reject buttons render. End-to-end pipeline confirmed: owner XLS upload -> pending -> admin approve -> values applied to solutions_store.quantitative_factors (upsert by factor_name, case-insensitive verified). Ownership boundaries (403 / 400 'Not your solution') and webhook auth (401 missing/invalid, 400 empty rows) all enforced. No critical or blocking issues detected. Minor: no testID attributes on new screens.

critical_code_review_comments: store_ingestion.py is 495 lines — clean & cohesive; uses httpx for gsheet fetch, openpyxl for xlsx, and proper FastAPI Depends auth for non-webhook routes. Webhook authenticates purely via X-Ingestion-Token header (as spec'd) and returns 401 for missing/invalid, 400 for empty rows — verified.

Solution ownership check in /upload returns 400 with 'Not your solution' rather than 403 — semantically 403 would be cleaner but functional behaviour matches request: 'should error for that solution_id'.
Factor-template endpoint correctly returns generic (non-prefilled) template for non-owner/non-admin requests on a foreign solution_id (no leak) — verified by test_non_owner_gets_generic_no_leak.
Approve flow upserts on factor_name case-insensitively — verified by test_approve_applies_to_solution (unique TestFactor_<uuid> persisted with value 77).

frontend bulk-factor-update.tsx reads sessionToken from useAuthStore and also falls back to AsyncStorage — correct; uses process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL — correct; uses expo-document-picker, expo-clipboard, expo-sharing, expo-file-system/legacy — all current.
No deprecated packages detected (no expo-av, no expo-barcode-scanner, no expo-background-fetch).
